text: Single file vault.py in Python; cryptography package allowed
Master password read from env VAULT_MASTER_KEY, never from a CLI argument
Fernet encryption with key derived by PBKDF2HMAC SHA-256, 200,000 iterations
Random 16-byte salt stored in the file header
Keys must match [a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64}; invalid keys rejected (exit 1)
Keys stored lowercase (case-insensitive lookup)
Values at most 4096 bytes UTF-8; larger rejected (exit 1)
TTL via --ttl DAYS, default 90
Expiry stored as ISO-8601
Commands set, get, list, delete, rotate, audit exist
get prints only the value to stdout
get exits 3 if expired and never prints an expired value
list shows value[:4] followed by *** and never the full value
rotate exits 1 if key does not exist
audit appends to ~/.vault/audit.log
audit shows last 20 lines
3 wrong passwords create a .lockout file; exit 2 on auth failure/lockout
Never write values to audit log or stderr
vault.enc chmod 600
~/.vault/ chmod 700
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 user error, 2 auth/lockout, 3 expired
delete removes a key; deleting missing key is user error (exit 1)
Missing VAULT_MASTER_KEY is an error (non-zero, not a crash)
